name: Reborne
description: You were once a member of another community, but you can no longer remember it.

features.name: Found Family
features.description:
Once per session, you can spend a Hope to use an ally's community ability. When you do, your ally gains a Hope.

At any point, when you've discovered the community you were once a part of, or have joined a new community, you can permanently trade this community card for that one instead.
